concept: Fixing or improving something instead of throwing it away when it's not quite right
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character's project doesn't turn out right the first time, and they fix or improve it instead of giving up
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character learn by fixing it instead of starting over or quitting?
exercise.practice: Student names something they could improve rather than abandon

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific improvement, not just 'I would try again'
